en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1773 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) said:

"Allah (swt), Blessed and Exalted, said: 'Fasting is for Me, and I will reward it.'
And the fasting person has two joys: one when he breaks his fast and one when he meets his Lord (azj), the Almighty. By the One in whose hand is the soul of Muhammad (sw), the breath of the fasting person is more fragrant to Allah (swt) than the scent of musk."
